response.overview: Milly's life is in shambles - she loses her job and her boyfriend all in one day. And if she can't come up with £96,000 pounds in 6 weeks, she'll also lose her lovely London home to her cheating ex. Lucky for her, an idle wish over a carved wooden elf changes everything. With a little Christmas magic, Milly is amazed to discover she is the sole beneficiary of her old neighbour's will. She has inherited a farm in the countryside. But to her dismay, all is not as rosy as it seems. The farm is falling apart and city girl Milly is out of her depth. But she refuses to give up and that determination earns her the respect of the locals, including a handsome horse trainer, Jack. Milly battles bad weather, the chaos of the farm and dodgy developers in an attempt to save the farm and get her flat back. And maybe, just maybe, find a little love along the way.
response.title: A Country Christmas Wish
